entries.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.comment: The reduced rate applies to royalties, please see chapter 9 section 16 paragraph 1 in the Swedish VAT Act (https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/mervardesskattelag-2023200_sfs-2023-200#K9). A performing artist`s (actor, musician, dancer, artist) performance of a literary or artistic work is exempt.
